```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
hp_list <- list(n_estimators = c(250,500,1000),
                           max_depth = c(5,8,15,20),
                           max_features=1:4)

hp_list <- list(n_estimators = c(10,20),
                           max_depth = c(3,5),
                           max_features=1:2)

cm_and_fscore <- function(probs){
  
  library(pROC)
  my_roc <- roc(dat_test$goal_YN, probs)
  auc <- pROC::auc(my_roc)
  cat("AUC:", auc, "\n\n")
  threshold <- coords(my_roc, "best", ret = "threshold",
         best.method="closest.topleft", best.weights=c(1,mean(dat_test$goal_YN==1))) %>% as.numeric()
  
  cat("Soglia:", threshold, "\n\n")
  
  cat("\n-------------------------")
  Fitted_goal <-  ifelse(probs >= threshold, 1, 0)
  
  f_score <- tibble(t=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
       e=factor(Fitted_goal, levels=c(0,1))) %>% f_meas(truth=t,
                  estimate=e, event_level = "second") %>% dplyr::select(.estimate) %>% as.numeric()
  cat("f-score:", f_score, "\n\n")
  
  caret::confusionMatrix(data=as.factor(Fitted_goal), reference=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN))
}
```

# Dati undersampled

```{r undersampled}
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_undersampled.Rdata")
glimpse(dat_undersampled)
table(dat_undersampled$goal_YN)
```


```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
source("my_randomForest2.R")
debug(cv_random_forest)
Us2 <- cv_random_forest(train = dat_undersampled %>%
                  mutate(goal_YN=factor(goal_YN,
                              levels=c(1,0), labels=c("1", "0"))),
            test = dat_test,
            hp_list = hp_list,
            n_folds = 5)
rm(dat_undersampled)

cm_and_fscore(probs = Us2)

save(Us2, file="../RF_pred/RF_undersampling2.Rdata")
rm(Us2)
```


# Dati originali

Primo approccio

```{r Dati originali}
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_cleaned.Rdata")
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test.Rdata")
str(dat_cleaned)
str(dat_test)
table(dat_cleaned$goal_YN)
```


```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
source("my_randomForest2.R")
Og2 <- cv_random_forest(train = dat_cleaned,
            test = dat_test,
            hp_list = hp_list,
            n_folds = 5)
rm(dat_cleaned)

tibble(t=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
        e=factor(Og2$pred, levels=c(0,1))) %>%
      yardstick::f_meas(truth=t, estimate=e, event_level = "second")

save(Og2, file="../RF_pred/RF_originali2.Rdata")
rm(Og2)
```
